999008199.text: それにしても、果ての大陸ってなんか寂しい場所だね

localizations.en: That said, World's End is kind of a lonely place, isn't it?

999008199.text:
うん、マナの結晶でキラキラしてるけど、
なんというか……無機質な感じがするというか……

localizations.en: Yeah... it sparkles with mana crystals, but there's something about it that feels so... lifeless.

999008199.text:
ここには食べものとかあるのかしら？
食べるものがないと動物も生きられないわよね

localizations.en: Is there anything to eat here? Animals can't survive without food.

999008199.text: ここに動物がいるなら、マナを食べて生きてたりして！

localizations.en: Maybe if there are animals here, they live off mana!

999008199.text:
っ！　みんな、ちょっと待って！
あそこ、何かいるわ

localizations.en: Hold on—everyone, stop! There's something over there.

999008199.text: あの、うにみたいにツンツンした生き物は……

localizations.en: That spiky little creature... is that...

999008199.text: この子、果ての大陸の生き物だったんだ……

localizations.en: So this little one is from World's End after all...

999008199.text:
前から気になってたけど、この生き物とレスナは
どうやって出会ったのさ？

localizations.en: I've always been curious—how did you and this little critter meet, anyway?

999008199.text:
え？　どうやってって言われても、
物心がついた時にはもう、ずっと一緒で……

localizations.en: Honestly? For as long as I can remember, we were just... always together.

999008199.text:
この子はね、レスナが祭壇に置かれていた時、
寄り添うように一緒にいたのよ

localizations.en: When we found Resna, she'd been left at a shrine. This little one was right there beside her, like it was watching over her.

999008199.text:
引き離すのもな、と思って一緒に引き取って
育てていたんだけど……

localizations.en: It didn't feel right to separate them, so I took them both home and raised them together...

999008199.text: ねえ、あなた……仲間の元に帰りたい？

localizations.en: Hey... do you want to go back? To be with your family?

999008199.text: あはは、レスナと一緒にいたいみたい

localizations.en: Haha—looks like it wants to stay with you.

999008199.text: この子も大切な仲間だもんね

localizations.en: It's one of us too, after all!

999008199.text: うん……これからも一緒だよ
